notes.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth - Trading Cards Dropping Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36535813/9b4b94c502b0530e1bb2547889392937d3662b95.png[/img]

[h4]Steam Community Items are now available in [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151440/Utawarerumono_Mask_of_Truth/]Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth[/url][/i], currently on sale at [b][i]75% OFF[/i][/b] until August 18th, 2022.[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36535813/133a967a43e93b4d0ee47a3fc1e13b49bc6608d4.png[/img]

Collect trading cards featuring the game's cast and craft them together to make badges, emoji, and profile backgrounds! Mask up your Steam profile page with the cast of the climactic third Utawarerumono game!

[hr][/hr]
Don't miss out on major deals on the whole [i]Utawarerumono[/i] series, currently on sale to celebrate the currently airing [i]Mask of Truth[/i] anime!
[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151450/Utawarerumono_Prelude_to_the_Fallen/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149550/Utawarerumono_Mask_of_Deception/

[hr][/hr]
The developers at AQUAPLUS are hard at work on their upcoming new RPG [i]Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten[/i], coming Oct. 20 worldwide to Steam. Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962430/Monochrome_Mobius_Rights_and_Wrongs_Forgotten/
